The monthly diet charges for students in welfare hostels were decreased by 5 percent.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: Statements 1 and 2 are correct as per the text. Statement 3 is incorrect because diet charges were increased by 10 percent, not decreased.

questions.title: AP Cabinet approves policy to attract foreign, private universities

questions.q: What is the total number of beneficiaries under the expanded Thalliki Vandanam scheme for 2026-27 as per the AP Cabinet decisions?
questions.why: The text states that the total number of beneficiaries under the Thalliki Vandanam scheme has reached 68,05,791.
